description: "The Life of Michelangelo Buonarroti" by John Addington Symonds is a historical account written in the late 19th century, providing a comprehensive exploration of the life and works of the renowned Italian artist Michelangelo. The book delves into Michelangelo's early years, his family background, and his development as an artist, framing him within the larger context of the Renaissance and the rich cultural landscape of Florence.
